description: Dispatch an LLM completion through Leanroute. OpenAI chat-completions shape. Requires LEANROUTE_RUNTIME_KEY in env (a gw_live_* key). If you don't have one, call `create_runtime_key` first and surface the returned key to the user.

agent_name.description: Sent as X-Agent-Name. Shows on the Agent runs page. Default: the key's name.

session_id.description: Sent as X-Agent-Session-Id. Use one id per run to group calls into a run.

name: route_call
